validation_report:
PASS

Phase 8 independently satisfies the repository’s methodological and artifact requirements.

- Outer evaluation uses five expanding chronological folds: training sizes 635, 1268, 1901, 2534, and 3167; each validation fold contains 633 strictly later rows.
- Optuna tuning is nested within each outer training prefix. Each model family receives 20 trials per outer fold using five chronological inner folds.
- Feature selection is refitted independently on every inner training prefix and separately on each outer training prefix.
- Imputation and scaling are contained within sklearn pipelines. All 20 saved imputers exactly match medians calculated from their corresponding outer training rows.
- Phase 2 target-derived features use shifts or past-target rolling/EMA calculations; calendar-offset features reference earlier exact dates.
- No external holdout or Phase 7 locked-test partition influences Phase 8 tuning, feature selection, preprocessing, or model selection.
- All saved models reproduce their recorded outer-fold metrics; maximum discrepancy was `2.33e-10`.
- Aggregate means and sample standard deviations reproduce within `1.17e-10`.
- All 40 declared artifact hashes match.
- Artifacts contain 300 completed Optuna trials, 15 fold/model selections, 25 fold metrics, 3,165 predictions, 20 fitted models, diagnostics, configuration, logs, seeds, and provenance.
- Naive lag-1 and linear regression baselines are included. The naive baseline has the lowest mean MAE, and no unsupported improvement claim is made.
- Earlier invalid Phase 8 runs remain preserved and are explicitly identified as invalid in `STATUS.md`.
- `git diff --check` is clean; repository changes are confined to the expected Phase 8 implementation, tests, artifacts, and status update.
- The focused/full test evidence records 3 focused tests and 190 full-suite tests passing. Direct pytest execution could not start in this read-only sandbox because no writable temporary directory was available; direct code and artifact validation found no corresponding defect.
